What We Do

Precision
Off-Road
Work

Focused off-road services — not a generic shop. Every job gets Austin's full attention and expertise, from diagnosis to final torque spec.

🔧
Suspension & Lift Kits

Proper lift installations with correct geometry, alignment, and component compatibility for Jeeps, Rams, Fords, and GMs.

⚙️
Differential Regearing

Axle regears dialed to your tire size and use case. Precision work that makes your rig perform the way it should.

🏗️
Custom Fabrication

Professional TIG & MIG welding for bumpers, sliders, mounts, skid plates, and custom off-road pieces.

🪝
Winch Installation

Hidden and exposed winch setups including Warn and other top brands — wired properly with the right mounting solution.

🔩
Axle & Leaf Spring Work

Leaf spring replacements, axle repairs, and corrections — including fixing botched installs from other shops.

🔍
Diagnostics & Corrections

Chasing down gremlins and fixing previous bad installs. Austin won't stop until the problem is found and resolved.
